title: Conformance kit: сценарий crash плагина, native без declared, swissknifeman conformance plugin|engine
summary: aicore ext conformance получает сценарий crash и работает с манифестом вне репозитория; declared сценарии привязки native в orch получают тест или golden-трассу (иначе declared с причиной), cao и claude-only — declared с причиной; swissknifeman conformance plugin|engine маршрутизирует через unit.json.
why: D82, E59, R13, R30; knowledge/hub-p12#conformance. Риски: (1) сценарий crash не должен двигать курсор доставки и терять событие; (2) тесты очистки процессов не воруют чужих потомков (supervise-процесс, как в conformance.py); (3) живые провайдеры в тестах запрещены — только фальшивые argv.

include: packages/aicore/lib/aicore/ext/conformance.py, delivery при необходимости, фикстура плагина, тесты
exclude: golden-трассы cao и claude-only (триггер паритета orch)

reads.why: факты кода на начало фазы: файлы, строки, функции

task_files.note: только если курсор двигается после краха

rules: Общие правила фазы — knowledge/hub-p12#rules (stdlib, хаб импортирует только aicore, umbrella без логики модулей и без литералов id, unit/v1 только аддитивно, временные HOME/SKM_HOME, генерируемое — генераторами, английский в продуктовых файлах, быстрые проверки в пункте, широкие — в phase.validation)
Дизайн — раздел knowledge из reads; имена команд, полей, кодов ошибок, путей и форматов — строго оттуда; отклонение или расхождение с кодом — open_issues отчёта (дирижёр пишет plan.py log)
Сценарий без теста остаётся declared только с полем reason; молча удалять сценарий нельзя
guidance:
Исполнитель: implementation/medium.

Порядок: crash в aicore (фикстура падающего плагина, курсор, повторная доставка) → тест чужого плагина из mkdtemp → orch native: child-process-cleanup, stdout-stderr-framing, workspace-permissions, lock-expiry (тест или golden-трасса на фальшивом argv) → reason у оставшихся declared → umbrella conformance → тесты → CHANGELOG → V1–V4.

validation.cmd: AICORE_ROOT=$PWD/packages/aicore python3 packages/orch/scripts/orch.py conformance --json | python3 -c 'import json, sys; rows = json.load(sys.stdin); bad = [r for r in rows if r.get("status") == "declared" and not r.get("reason")]; assert not bad, bad'

H=$(mktemp -d) && HOME=$H SKM_HOME=$H/skm bin/swissknifeman conformance engine --binding native --json > $H/e.json && python3 -c 'import json, sys; json.load(open(sys.argv[1]))' $H/e.json && python3 scripts/test-umbrella.py

deliverables: conformance native без declared без причины

result.notes:
aicore ext conformance gets a new last scenario `crash`: a plugin that exits non-zero or dies by a signal while handling an invoke or event fails with evidence `call=...` and `exit_code=N` or `signal=NAME`, plus the remediation from the design. Skipped when an earlier call timed out. The CLI accepts `--manifest PATH` besides the positional manifest; giving both is an error and giving none exits 2. New fixtures: plugins `crash` (subscriber, exit 3) and `crash-signal` (command, SIGKILL), and subscriber `killed.py`. Tests copy fixtures into a fresh temp dir and run them by path, and test_delivery pins that a subscriber killed by SIGKILL leaves the cursor in place, sets pending PROCESS_EXIT, and redelivers the same event once fixed (delivery.py needed no change). Orch: new tests/test_native_conformance.py, all on fake argv: child-process-cleanup (grandchild gone after idle timeout, linger and cancel; a bystander in another session survives), stdout-stderr-framing (separate raw and .stderr files, failure detail from stderr only), and workspace-permissions (writes outside write_set are found from the git tree via scope.dirty/outside). These three scenarios are now `covered` for native with a ref in scenarios.json. For cao and claude-only they stay declared with a reason that names the orch parity trigger (ADR 0062). lock-expiry stays n/a with its existing reason. orch test_conformance.py and docs/conformance.md updated. Umbrella: `conformance` alias in configs/umbrella.json with routes plugin (aicore ext conformance) and engine (orch conformance), both found via provides.cli. scripts/umbrella.py prints a usage error (exit 2) when a known alias has no matching route. test-umbrella.py gets TestConformanceRoutes. Golden help cases recaptured. Both CHANGELOGs updated. Narrow tests all pass (see the list above).
Changed: CHANGELOG.md, configs/umbrella.json, packages/aicore/CHANGELOG.md, packages/aicore/lib/aicore/ext/cli.py, packages/aicore/lib/aicore/ext/conformance.py, packages/aicore/tests/ext/fixtures/plugins/crash-signal/extension.json, packages/aicore/tests/ext/fixtures/plugins/crash-signal/plugin.py, packages/aicore/tests/ext/fixtures/plugins/crash/extension.json, packages/aicore/tests/ext/fixtures/plugins/crash/plugin.py, packages/aicore/tests/ext/fixtures/subscribers/killed.py, packages/aicore/tests/ext/test_conformance.py, packages/aicore/tests/ext/test_delivery.py, packages/orch/conformance/scenarios.json, packages/orch/docs/conformance.md, packages/orch/tests/test_conformance.py, packages/orch/tests/test_native_conformance.py, scripts/test-umbrella.py, scripts/umbrella.py, tests/golden/cases.json, tests/golden/cli/swissknifeman-help.txt, tests/golden/cli/swissknifeman-unknown-subcommand.txt, tests/golden/generation.json
deviations: configs/umbrella.json is outside write_set, but the `conformance` alias lives there (routes are data by hub rule 2, and umbrella.py may not hold module ids). Edited it by necessity.
D82 and the goal say `--manifest <path>`, but the CLI had a positional MANIFEST. Kept the positional and added `--manifest` as an equivalent option.
changed outside the write set: configs/umbrella.json
